title: How to Prevent Silver Tarnish in Long-Term Storage: Anti-Tarnish Strips, VCI Capsules, and What to Avoid
description: Silver tarnishes when hydrogen sulfide reacts with the metal surface. Here's how to block it with anti-tarnish strips, airtight capsules, and humidity control below 50% RH.
alt: Silver tarnish prevention guide showing anti-tarnish strips, VCI capsules, and 50% relative humidity rule
